name: Blinding Energy (General)
body:
Your channeled energy can be used to cause blindness in those it affects.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy class feature.

Benefit(s): In addition to the normal effects of your channeled energy, you can cause blindness in those normally affected by your channeling. Channeling in this way requires you to utilize an additional use of your channeled energy ability. Creatures which would normally be unaffected by your channeled energy use are unaffected by this effect. The blindness may be negated by a successful Fortitude save where the DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Charisma modifier.
